Home / Property types

Every property deserves the right care.

A flat in a 300-unit tower and an independent house on a quiet ECR road need different attention. The plan is shaped around the property, not a fixed package.

Apartments & Flats

Ongoing care for individual flats: association coordination, tenant communication and maintenance follow-up.

Apartment ownership comes with an association, shared services and neighbours above and below. We coordinate with the society on notices and dues, keep an eye on common-area issues that affect your flat, and handle the tenant or vacancy care inside it.

Explore this service

Villas & Independent Houses

Regular property checks, garden and exterior upkeep, and vendor coordination for standalone homes.

A standalone house has no association to notice a problem. Gardens, compound walls, overhead tanks, terraces and gates all need someone to look. Visits are planned around the monsoon and your travel, and repairs are coordinated with vendors who know the area.

Explore this service

Rental Properties

Tenant enquiries, move-in and move-out coordination, rent follow-ups and agreement-renewal reminders.

A let property needs two things done well: the tenant looked after, and the money and paperwork tracked. Tenant Management and Rental Management cover both; most owners take them together.

Explore this service

Commercial Properties & Offices

Maintenance coordination and routine oversight for small offices and commercial units.

Small offices and commercial units need maintenance coordination, access management and liaison with the building's management. We cover routine oversight; fit-out projects are quoted separately.

Explore this service

Vacant Properties

Scheduled checks, condition updates, cleaning and upkeep coordination while the property is unoccupied.

An unoccupied property needs regular ventilation, drain checks, bill reminders and a presence the society recognises. Monthly visits are typical, with readiness support when a tenant or a family visit is coming.

Explore this service
